sections.h2: FCI-based rations would cost 62% less per unit than private vendor rations

chart.title: The proposed FCI route cuts unit cost from ₹71 to ₹27 on the deck's own figures
chart.source: Jai Kisan, Jai Javan strategy deck (proposal, unverified).

sections.means: The deck's own table puts the proposed FCI route at ₹27 per unit against ₹71 for private vendors, a 62% cut.
sections.todo: Ask the proposers to show how the ₹71 to ₹27 unit cost is derived before the ₹2.85 Cr Year-1 setup budget is approved.

sections.h2: The FCI channel carries 50% of the sourcing plan, the largest of five routes

chart.title: FCI takes ₹150 Cr of the ₹300 Cr procurement, ahead of State Boards at ₹60 Cr
chart.source: Jai Kisan, Jai Javan strategy deck (proposal).

sections.means: Half of the ₹300 Cr value runs through FCI, but the deck does not say whether ₹300 Cr is an annual or cumulative figure.
sections.todo: Direct the coordination across State Boards, APMC, NAFED and FPOs only once the ₹300 Cr total is shown year by year.

sections.h2: Soya mock meat matches fish curry's 16g protein per serving at ₹32 against ₹48

chart.title: Animal-protein pouches top the protein chart, but soya reaches 16g for less
chart.source: Jai Kisan, Jai Javan strategy deck (proposal).

sections.means: Soya mock meat at ₹32 a pouch gives the same 16g as fish curry at ₹48, which suggests the protein target need not rely on non-vegetarian rations.
sections.todo: Run the tasting and field campaigns the deck proposes with soya and animal-protein pouches side by side before full rollout.
